name: excel-vba-mcp
description: A bundled read-only MCP server for discovering workbooks already open in Excel.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex to the Excel VBA MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Phase 2 adds safe, temporary discovery of workbooks already open in Excel. The server never starts, opens, saves, closes, or quits Excel.
interface.defaultPrompt: List the workbooks currently open in Excel and report their saved and read-only status.
